notes: s2f2/s2f3: 'north of the summit' is read as from the site itself (the summit of the tell is the site's centre), so relative_to unit. Plan Fig. 36 (north arrow about 13 deg W of page-up, 0-30 m bar) agrees: one 'Cave' among the 'Rocks with Installations' lies c. 45 m at c. 343 deg from the summit; a second 'Cave' lies c. 30 m WNW. Not used as plan positions because the unit point cannot be placed on the plan (the printed grid 1944/2014 is c. 410 m from the unit point). Not coded: winepress elements and cup marks; Robinson's 'fountain' and Masterman's spring (no pool described).
